shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "ls -la && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'! .git'"' | sed -n '1,120p' && printf '\\n--- top-level project files ---\\n' && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!*lock*'"' | sed -n '1,160p'"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- package.json ---' && cat package.json && printf '%s\\n' '--- next.config.ts ---' && cat next.config.ts && for f in app/*.tsx; do printf '\\n--- %s ---\\n' \""'$f"; sed -n '"'1,240p' \""'$f"; done && printf '"'\\n--- git status ---\\n' && git status --short && printf '\\n--- recent history ---\\n' && git log --oneline -5"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- initial commit files ---' && git show --stat --oneline HEAD && printf '\\n--- initial page ---\\n' && git show HEAD:app/page.tsx && printf '\\n--- eval metadata ---\\n' && find __agent_eval__ -maxdepth 2 -type f -print -exec sed -n '1,200p' {} \\;"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && printf '\\n--- diff stat ---\\n' && git diff --stat && printf '\\n--- app diff ---\\n' && git diff -- app next.config.ts tsconfig.json && printf '\\n--- prerender artifacts ---\\n' && find .next/server/app -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort | sed -n '1,100p'"
/bin/bash -lc "rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts && git checkout -- tsconfig.json && git status --short && printf '\\n--- shell markers ---\\n' && git diff -- app/page.tsx app/loading.tsx app/data.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check && printf '\\n--- line references ---\\n' && nl -ba app/page.tsx && printf '\\n' && nl -ba app/data.ts && printf '\\n' && nl -ba app/loading.tsx && printf '\\n--- final status ---\\n' && git status --short"
